name: Arvind Fashions Ltd
about: Arvind Fashions Ltd operates in the branded apparels, beauty and footwear space. It has a portfolio of several owned and licensed global brands across different segments. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Arvind Limited is a leading textile and apparel company that manufactures and distributes fabrics, garments, and advanced materials. The company operates across multiple business verticals, including textiles, denim, advanced materials, and retail.

cons: Stock is trading at 6.82 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.04% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.11% over last 3 years.
